stage.name: Nanwu Vows
stage.description:
Vows have been sworn. All that is left is to triumph.
Fight the foe you picked; Losing will not deduct Life Points. Defeating a tougher foe within the given time grants a better reward
stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row

arc_screenguard.name: Arc Screenguard
arc_screenguard.flavourText: Soldiers from an experimental unit with formidable defenses using the most advanced alloy technologies. However, the unresolved instability of the material makes them better suited for short, high-pressure skirmishes than drawn-out battles.
abilities: Starting DEF and RES are high, but reduced whenever damage is taken

bottle_swordsman.name: Bottle Swordsman
bottle_swordsman.flavourText: Once a wandering physician's medicine bottle, it provided healing to many warriors. When it became a geist, it was moved by a talisman and put the talisman in its bottle, embarking on a journey of chivalry.
abilities: Starts with 3 <Talismans>; attacks attach a <Talisman> to the target when carrying a <Talisman>

cabbage_seedling.name: Cabbage Seedling
cabbage_seedling.flavourText: A small, common fae, the original form of Patrolling Foliage. Completely harmless if separated from fire.
abilities: Can be ignited by <Burning Vine> or <Burning Wick>
When defeated while ignited, deals a large amount of Arts damage to surrounding units

heavy_crossbowman_ambusher.name: Heavy Crossbowman Ambusher
heavy_crossbowman_ambusher.flavourText: A sniper issued with a mass-produced kinetically-boosted crossbow. Though expensive, they are well worth the price tag, capable of stunning targets for long durations after being charged up.
abilities: Invisible
Launches a Straight Shot when positioned in a straight line with an allied unit: fires 1 bolt in the target's direction that deals Arts damage and inflicts Stun

mirror_tianshi.name: Mirror Tianshi
mirror_tianshi.flavourText: A well-polished mirror that believes it sees everything clearly. When it became a Geist, it was not content with just seeing things, but could not stop itself from giving unsolicited advice, just like the old scholars in the Tianshi Bureau.
abilities: Picks a target from very long range, dealing Arts damage and sending a <Talisman>

mutant_sand_beast_enemy_1131_sbeast.name: Mutant Sand Beast
mutant_sand_beast_enemy_1131_sbeast.flavourText: A sand beast infected by an Originiutant. Sand beasts are a species of small-sized omnivores that primarily inhabit deserts and hamadas. They are nocturnal in nature and are often tamed by the local Sargonians to be used as hunting beasts.
abilities: Splits into 2 <Originiutant Excrescences> upon death

raiton_master.name: Raiton Master
raiton_master.flavourText: A ninja obsessed with technology, wielding a kendama-shaped flash drive filled with deadly spam. Completely unbound by anyone, they quickly leap to avoid danger.
abilities: Briefly takes off when colliding with <'Certain Fates'>, blocked, or encountering a Hole.

sarkaz_wither_bulwark.name: Sarkaz Wither Bulwark
sarkaz_wither_bulwark.flavourText: Veteran guards of the Nachzehrer King's legions. Martyrs who advance to certain death knowing that others will carry their blood soaked shield.

scrap_assembler.name: Scrap Assembler
scrap_assembler.flavourText: Mercenaries fascinated with building new equipment and moving heavier equipment by adding more power.
abilities: Temporarily takes flight when blocked or facing a Stabilizer Chain for the first time. DEF is greatly reduced after landing.

shrine_marksman.name: Shrine Marksman
shrine_marksman.flavourText: Selected to guard key areas of the Shrine of Nurtury and ensure that the Nativity goes smoothly. They are still unfamiliar with the sniper rifles in their hands, and often accidentally damage the statues of saints on the streets.
abilities: Performs extremely long-ranged attacks while holding Ammo. Ammo capacity: 1
Stops and reloads if out of Ammo

ursus_civilian.name: Ursus Civilian
ursus_civilian.flavourText: An ordinary Ursus citizen caught in the crossfire. A part of the cruelty and suffering of this world.
abilities: Does not deplete Life Points when spared, but will deplete a Life Point upon dying
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter

worry_free_cargo_helper.name: Worry-Free Cargo Helper
worry_free_cargo_helper.flavourText: It will brave the chaos and deliver the goods safely to their destination, even when all hell is breaking loose on Rhodes Island. Whether the goods themselves are dangerous is none of its concern.
abilities: Flying unit.
Self-destructs immediately when there is an Operator nearby, dealing a large amount of Arts damage to surrounding units

bejeweled_slab_guardian.name: 'Bejeweled Slab Guardian'
bejeweled_slab_guardian.flavourText: Strange entities sighted amongst the jewel constructs. The bejeweled stone slabs that they carry shine brightly in the night streets, like glowing great swords.
abilities: More likely to be attacked
Starts with low DEF and RES, but permanently gains DEF when taking Physical damage and RES when taking Arts damage, up to a maximum.

millscar_elite_mercenary.name: 'Millscar' Elite Mercenary
millscar_elite_mercenary.flavourText: A member of one of Londinium's underground insurgent forces and a seasoned mercenary, happy to snatch anything from debtors. No one who asked what turned them this way has lived to get an answer.
abilities: Can equip gear, max 3 different types
When approaching other enemies equipped with gear, collects that gear if its type is not already being equipped, up to a max of 3 different types

traffic_tower_prototype.name: 'Traffic Tower' Prototype
traffic_tower_prototype.flavourText: A robot primarily developed by Volvort Kochinski, the crystallization of cutting-edge advances in every field. If they could lower the cost of production to make it feasible for mass-production, perhaps it could even change the nature of warfare.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 4 Block
DEF and RES is reduced whenever damage is taken
When destroyed, ejects a <'Traffic Officer Captain'> and self-destructs, dealing physical damage to nearby units

alloy_surfing_instructor.name: Alloy Surfing Instructor
alloy_surfing_instructor.flavourText: A sturdy mechanical surfing instructor that can withstand water and corrosion. High-density rare alloys were incorporated to increase its resistance to rust, but as such, it sinks even harder.
abilities: Can stop <Self-Driving Carts>
When not blocked, Physical and Arts damage taken is significantly reduced

battleline_advance_guard.name: Battleline Advance Guard
battleline_advance_guard.flavourText: Heavily-armed personnel in charge of advancing the frontline. Typically made up of grumpy old veterans who take out their anger towards their superiors on anything standing in their way.
abilities: Each time this unit is blocked, the next attack's ATK is greatly increased.

bounty_hunter_grand_knight.name: Bounty Hunter 'Grand Knight'
bounty_hunter_grand_knight.flavourText: Bounty hunters skilled in witchcraft, aspiring to join the Kazimierzian knight competitions once they've saved enough money. For now, their greatest joy remains tormenting their targets as they hunt them down.
abilities: Accelerates when moving. First attack after being blocked deals extra Arts damage based on movement speed.

burning_vine.name: Burning Vine
burning_vine.flavourText: Passionate fae, the fire in its heart like a torch under a strange arch. The flowers and vines wrapping around it are merely decorative.
abilities: Attacks inflict additional Burn
ATK continuously increases before its first attack, and the first attack deals a large amount of Arts damage and Burn to the target and surrounding units

chalice_of_regret.name: Chalice of Regret
chalice_of_regret.flavourText: Soul chalice born of a revenant's will, brimming with regret unfathomable. The past, tormenting yet unchangeable, is the cruelest cut.
abilities: Flying unit.
Shares a fraction of the damage taken by non-aerial enemies around itself.

duck_lord.name: Duck Lord
duck_lord.flavourText: A famous Columbian investor, entrepreneur, and master of 'Duck Power.' Out of the public eye, enjoys kicking back with others...
abilities: Cannot be blocked.
Gains significantly increased Movement Speed after being attacked

father_agenir.name: Father Agenir
father_agenir.flavourText: Agenir, Sankta priest, one of the founders of Siracusa's ironclad order. Do not hesitate–though he does not necessarily stand opposed to you, his guns speak first. By the way, his favorite eye mask was made in Lungmen.
abilities: Gradually increases Blood Debt
Attacks have global range when Asset Liquidation is active
Attacks using Ammo decrease the target's DEF. Ammo capacity: 10

fortuna_fallen_angel.name: Fortuna, Fallen Angel
fortuna_fallen_angel.flavourText: A fallen Sankta girl, the innocent and ignorant Fortuna. With her dimmed halo and black horns, paradise has closed its doors on her. What has actually changed, and what has not?
abilities: While this unit is holding Ammo, attacks become long-ranged and deal a large amount of Physical damage. Ammo capacity: 6
Has a chance to miss ranged attacks

gopnik.name: Gopnik
gopnik.flavourText: The Ursus security guard hired by Duck Lord. Powerful, but not very smart. Mainly responsible for carrying luggage for Duck Lord.

imperial_artillery_core_targeteer.name: Imperial Artillery Core Targeteer
imperial_artillery_core_targeteer.flavourText: A heavily-armored, sturdily-built core drone operated by artillery technicians of the Ursus army. They presage the withering firepower of the Ursus Artillery. The Ursus Artillery is a fire team that has bunkered down into the city. Though packing less firepower than naval guns, their equipment still shreds through buildings and armor with ease.
abilities: Flying unit.

mio_the_eager_examinant.name: Mio, the Eager Examinant
mio_the_eager_examinant.flavourText: Friend? Foe? Mio doesn't care. Mio does what it must.
abilities: Attacks deal Arts splash damage in a cross.
ATK and HP increase with the number of Crystals on the field, up to a maximum.

mockup_auto_meal_distributor.name: Mockup Auto Meal Distributor
mockup_auto_meal_distributor.flavourText: Cafeteria meal distributor that is still in beta testing. A busy operator had the bright idea to attach a maintenance helper to it—to save the effort of walking from the dorms to the cafeteria—but the timing of the test was unfortunate to say the least.
abilities: Periodically summons 1 <Confused Maintenance Helper>

mutant_giant_rock_spider_enemy_1133_harc.name: Mutant Giant Rock Spider
mutant_giant_rock_spider_enemy_1133_harc.flavourText: A giant rock spider infected by an Originiutant. Giant rock spiders are a subspecies of rock spider found only in Sargon. They possess a large circular abdomen used to store energy.
abilities: Periodically creates an <Originiutant Excrescence>
Splits into 4 <Originiutant Excrescences> upon death

pseudomut.name: Pseudomut
pseudomut.flavourText: Similar in appearance to a Feranmut, it looks like an ancient 'God', but it is no more than a mere beast. It has become extinct in modern times, for its greed never diminished, despite no longer having the reputation of the Feranmuts to draw from.
abilities: When blocked for the first time, devours the blocker and gains Low-Altitude Hovering
Returns devoured Operator when defeated

saltfin_shaker.name: Saltfin Shaker
saltfin_shaker.flavourText: Despite its size and weight, this saltfin is surprisingly lithe when swimming through the salts. Normally gentle in nature, it can shake the salt fields and cause land subsidence with its powerful slamming attacks when provoked.
abilities: Attacks deal Physical splash damage to all nearby allied units
Immune to the effects of Salt Flat and gains increased Movement Speed while in Salt Flat

sarkaz_bloodwalker.name: Sarkaz Bloodwalker
sarkaz_bloodwalker.flavourText: A special entity within the Crimson Court, ensuring that no touch of the Crimson's dominion over blood goes to waste. They collect the essence condensed from the blood spilled on the battlefield and wait for it to be given form again through the ancient rituals of the vampires.
abilities: Cannot be blocked.
Collects up to 5 pieces of dropped <Blood Amber>. When defeated, drops all collected <Blood Amber>.

sarkaz_boneguard.name: Sarkaz Boneguard
sarkaz_boneguard.flavourText: A guard responsible for protecting the Feranmut's skeleton. As some of the most loyal adherents of the Military Commission, they will carry out their duties at any cost, even if they must shed their own blood.
abilities: More likely to be attacked by friendly units.
Upon receiving damage, reduces the ASPD of the attacker.
Prevents <Anti-Witchcraft Repositionable Bombs> from moving when nearby.
Leaves behind 2 <Blood Amber> when defeated.

sarkaz_lancer_leader.name: Sarkaz Lancer Leader
sarkaz_lancer_leader.flavourText: A Sarkaz, more threatening than a normal Sarkaz Lancer. After special training, they are capable of rushing forward with a long spear, building up speed. The faster they charge, the harder they strike anyone who might stand in their way.
abilities: Gradually accelerates when moving, and deals additional damage on the first attack after being blocked based upon Movement Speed.

scarletmist.name: Scarletmist
scarletmist.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. Crystalline and adorned with engravings of dragons and phoenixes, a Waregeist of this type is mysterious and imposing in nature, though it is also extremely irritable in temperament and very aggressive.
abilities: After several attacks, inflicts continuous Arts damage that slowly increases over time (can be Resisted)
Spawns 1 <Porcelain Vase> when defeated

sharpedge.name: Sharpedge
sharpedge.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. The weaponry yet again dreams of the past. A Waregeist of this type rouses its old memories as though it is taking to the battlefield again. Its strength is doubled as it and its peers rally each other.
abilities: Consumes Broken Blades to gain increased ATK
When defeated, each unconsumed Broken Blade will spawn a <Iron Spearhead> (minimum 1)

shrine_nurturer.name: Shrine Nurturer
shrine_nurturer.flavourText: Nurturers of the Shrine of Nurtury selected to ensure that the Nativity goes smoothly. They are still unfamiliar with their jobs and often lose Enlightened Pacifiers, or mix up the nurseries of newborn humans and animals.
abilities: Periodically restores HP and reloads 1 ammo for 3 nearby enemies

spatula_giant.name: Spatula Giant
spatula_giant.flavourText: Mercenaries are adept at building makeshift weapons from whatever is available. This massive, sputtering machine shambles forward, brandishing Lateran kitchen utensils while leaking fuel.
abilities: Unblockable
Loses a percentage of HP over time against a Stabilizer Chain.

strange_gourd.name: Strange Gourd
strange_gourd.flavourText: A gourd that turned into a geist, with an incessant desire for hoarding despite not being particularly active. When disturbed, it tries to draw everything around it into its interior.
abilities: Strange Gourd gains increased HP and ATK based on the amount of Originium Ingots owned
Steals Originium Ingots upon entering the Objective.

suiton_master.name: Suiton Master
suiton_master.flavourText: A ninja that attacks by spinning in place. Claims that creating a vortex from air is a type of suiton too, even without water around him. Nobody wants to go out with him because he refuses to walk properly.
abilities: Deals Physical damage to surroundings while spinning, and stops spinning when shifted
Bounces <'Certain Fates'>

terrible_chef.name: Terrible Chef
terrible_chef.flavourText: More butcher than cook, the fleet's chefs are more adept at dismembering carcasses than making the aftermath fit for human consumption. No sailor who has seen one dismember a saltfin has the guts to complain about their cooking.
abilities: More likely to be attacked
Nearby enemies and <Saltheap Cannons> take far less Physical/Arts damage from sources in the direction of the shield

theater_golem.name: Theater Golem
theater_golem.flavourText: A gigantic golem maintained by the Crimson Troupe's prop department, they are normally used to move bulky items. They are massive and difficult to block.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 4 Block
Attacks deal Splash damage to allied units in a small area around self

transport_vessel.name: Transport Vessel
transport_vessel.flavourText: A general-use aircraft designed by the Industry Development Association for transporting goods. Some members suggest that having a pilot atop might deter ruffians from shooting it down, fearing the risk of murder.
abilities: Attacks hit 3 times
Deals a large amount of Physical damage to all units in a fixed range when defeated and drops random gear

whiskey_grade_waker_upper.name: Whiskey-Grade Waker-Upper
whiskey_grade_waker_upper.flavourText: A terrifying machine that sweeps across the beach, equipped with an ultra-powerful water cannon strong enough to blast any drunkard to their senses. After someone secretly tampered with its targeting logic, it now only blasts sober people.
abilities: Upon taking damage for the first time, gains significantly increased ASPD and Movement Speed for a period of time

yeti_icecleaver_leader.name: Yeti Icecleaver Leader
yeti_icecleaver_leader.flavourText: A special melee combatant of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected gerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra. Experienced executioners on the battlefield, they wield long katanas that can easily ravage frozen Operators, and their nickname, 'Ice Cleaver,' references their devastating blows that seem strong enough to split glaciers.
abilities: Attack power increases greatly when attacking Frozen targets

frost_buck.name: 'Frost Buck'
frost_buck.flavourText: An actor playing the role of the Sami Snowpriest's bodyguard, 'Frost Buck'. After countless performances, they have fallen completely into their role, and wish for their demise at the hands of a foe as scary as the 'Demons'.
abilities: Attack power increases greatly when attacking Frozen targets
When <'Snow Doe'> dies, greatly increases ASPD and Movement Speed, and inherits its ability

snow_doe.name: 'Snow Doe'
snow_doe.flavourText: An actor playing the role of the Sami Snowpriest's bodyguard, 'Snow Doe'. After countless performances, they have fallen completely into their role, and wish for their demise at the hands of a foe as twisted as the 'Frozen Monstrosity'.
abilities: Attacks inflict Cold
When <'Frost Buck'> dies, greatly increases ASPD and Movement Speed, and inherits its ability

wandering_puppet.name: Wandering Puppet
wandering_puppet.flavourText: A musical puppet maintained by the Crimson Troupe's prop department. All who have heard its bewitching melodies have turned as one towards the Crimson Troupe, and were never seen again.
abilities: When not blocked, continuously deals Arts damage to all allied units
